x-k-k8-04.title: Indlela ukukhuluma kwabasebenzi ababili okushintsha ngayo
x-k-k8-04.goal: Qagela ubudlelwano ngezingcezu ezincane zengxoxo, ubuyekeze ukuqagela njengoba kufika ulwazi olwengeziwe, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani izinga lokukhuluma lodwa lalingenele ekuqaleni.
x-k-k8-04.material: Abasebenzi ababili, 선우 no-하린, ezikhathini ezintathu. Funda ingxenye ngayinye, khetha okungenzeka kakhulu, bese uqhubeka.
x-k-k8-04.thinking.1: Ukuqaphela lokho umhlangano wokuqala ongakubonisa nongakubonisi
x-k-k8-04.thinking.2: Ukuhlulela ukuthi yiziphi izimpendulo zakamuva ezemvelo
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula ukuthi yiziphi izimo ababili abazisebenzisayo komunye nomunye.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuthi umhlangano wokuqala phakathi kwabantu abadala uvame ukuzwakala kanjani, noma kunjani iminyaka yabo.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.info:
Usuku lokuqala ehhovisi.
선우: 안녕하세요, 이번에 입사한 선우입니다.
하린: 아, 반가워요. 저는 하린이에요.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Abantu abadala ababili abahlangana okokuqala bavame ukusebenzisa ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho kwe--요 ezinhlangothini zombili, ngakho ingxoxo ibonisa ibanga, hhayi izinga.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Abangani abasondelene bebengeke bazethule ngale ndlela.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Abangaziwa abakhuluma ngenhlonipho komunye nomunye; akukho lutho ngeminyaka noma izinga okwamanje.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Bobabili basebenzisa ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho ngendlela efanayo. Akukho ukungalingani okwamanje.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.info:
Emasontweni amabili kamuva.
하린: 선우 씨, 점심 같이 먹을래요?
선우: 네, 좋아요. 어디로 갈까요?
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Isimemo sesidlo sasemini sikhombisa ukukhululeka, hhayi ushintsho ezingeni lokukhuluma. Ulimi lusalingana.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Basenenhlonipho kodwa bakhululekile kakhulu, futhi akukho lutho olukhombisa ukuthi ubani omdala.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Azikho izihloko zenhlonipho noma izenzo ezithobekile.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ukumema isidlo sasemini kunobungane, kodwa inkulumo isenenhlonipho futhi iyalingana.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.info:
Isidlo sakusihlwa seqembu.
하린: 선우 씨, 몇 년생이에요?
선우: 98년생이에요. 하린 씨는요?
하린: 나는 96이야. 그럼 나는 말 편하게 할게. 선우 씨는 편한 대로 해.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: 선우 cishe ukhuluma kanjani ku-하린 ngokulandelayo?
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 하린 uvumela ukukhuluma kwakhe ngoba ungomdala; 선우 ukhululekile ukukhetha. Izindlela ezimbili zinengqondo: hlala nge--요, noma ugcobhoze ukuphela okungajwayelekile isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Ukushintshela ngokuphelele ku-반말 (no-하린아) kuzodinga ukusondelana okwengeziwe noma isimemo sakhe esicacile.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Agcina ukuphela okunenhlonipho kwe--요 (isib. 네, 저는 이대로 할게요).
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ushintshela ngokuphelele ku-반말 futhi umbiza ngokuthi 하린아.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wavumela u-선우 ukuthi akhethe, kodwa akukho okusho ukuthi kufanele alahle inhlonipho, futhi ukusebenzisa igama lakhe nge-아 kungaba ngokujwayelekile kakhulu ngomehluko weminyaka emibili.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Uxuba ukuphela okungajwayelekile okuthile ekukhulumeni kwe--요 (isib. 네, 하린 씨, 고마워!).
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Uhamba ekukhulumeni okuqinile kakhulu kwe--습니다 ukukhombisa inhlonipho.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ngemuva kokuthi ekhulule ukukhuluma kwakhe futhi wammemela ukuthi akhululeke, ukuqina kwakuzozwakala kude.
x-k-k8-04.s.s1.reflect: Ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho kwabobabili ekuhlanganeni kokuqala kusho okuncane ngobudala noma isikhundla. Amaqiniso amasha, njengobudala nemvume yokukhulula ulimi, ashintsha isithombe.
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.prompt: NgesiNgisi: engxenyeni yokuqala, ubungasitshela ukuthi ubani omdala? Sho lokho obukwazi nokungakwazi ukukuphetha, nokuthi yimuphi ulwazi owawudinga. Cashuna okungenani ibinzana elilodwa lesiKorea.
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.0: Phinda ufunde ingxenye 1 ubhale yonke ifomu elihluka phakathi kwabakhulumi ababili.
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bese uhlola ukuthi yimuphi umugqa engxenyeni 3 onikeza iqiniso elilahlekile.
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngisho yini engxenyeni yokuqala ebingeke isitshele?
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngiqambe ubufakazi bakamuva obenze isithombe sacaca?
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ukuqagela kwami kokuqala kuhlukile embonweni wami wokugcina, futhi ngisho ukuthi kungani?
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.model.0: Cha. Ku-안녕하세요 no-반가워요 kokubili kwasebenzisa ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho, ngakho kwakhombisa kuphela ukuthi babengazani. Ngangidinga iminyaka noma isihloko; ngakufunda ku-98년생 no-96 engxenyeni yokugcina.
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.model.1: Angikwazanga ukusho. 하린 wathi 반가워요 no-선우 wathi 입사한 선우입니다, okunenhlonipho kodwa kulinganayo. Iminyaka yokuzalwa engxenyeni yokugcina kuphela eyakhombisa ukuthi ubani omdala.
x-k-k8-04.s.s2.model.2: Engxenyeni 1 bobabili basebenzise ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho (안녕하세요, 반가워요), ngakho angikwazanga ukusho ukuthi ubani omdala. Ngangidinga iminyaka yabo; ngayithola ku-98년생 no-96 kamuva.

x-k-k8-10.title: Ubani owephule ifasitela?
x-k-k8-10.goal: Buyekeza isahlulelo ngokuthi ubani unesibopho njengoba imisho enezindima ezahlukene zohlelo lolimi ivela, bese ubika isehlakalo ngobulungisa.
x-k-k8-10.material: Ifasitela lesikole liphukile. Funda ingxenye ngayinye, ukhethe ukufunda okunengqondo kakhulu, bese uqhubeka.
x-k-k8-10.thinking.0: Ukufunda lokho umusho ongenaye owenzayo ukwenzayo nokungakwenzi
x-k-k8-10.thinking.1: Ukubuyekeza isahlulelo njengoba ubufakazi obusha buvela
x-k-k8-10.prereq.0: Uhlangene nezibili zezenzo ezisebenzayo nezokwenziwa ezinjenge-깨다 ne-깨지다
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi yimuphi umuntu, uma ekhona, umusho oqamba njengonenzile.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa lokho umusho ngamunye okushoyo ngempela nalokho okucabanga kuphela.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.0.info:
Ibhodi lezaziso lesikole.
어제 오후 3층 교실의 유리창이 깨졌습니다.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Lesi saziso sikutshela ini ngokuthi ubani owephule ifasitela?
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.0.after: 깨졌습니다 ayinaye owenzayo. Isho umphumela ngaphandle kokusho ukuthi ubani noma yini okubangele.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Umusho awusho ukuthi bekungekho mbangela; awusho nje.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akukho okukhombisa ukusola; ifomu elingenaye owenzayo yindlela engathathi hlangothi yokubika.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.1.info:
Kamuva, iphini lenhloko yesikole ekhulumela emsindweni.
유리창을 깬 학생은 교무실로 오세요.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kushintshe ini ngendlela isehlakalo esitshelwa ngayo?
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.1.after: 깬 isimo esisebenzayo: sicabanga ukuthi othile wephule ifasitela. Isaziso sokuqala salishiya livulekile.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 깬 학생 iqamba umfundi njengowenzayo, hhayi uthisha.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Manje icabanga ukuthi umuntu wephule ifasitela.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Akukho okushintshile; 깬 ne-깨진 kusho into efanayo.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Qhathanisa 유리창이 깨졌다 ne-유리창을 깼다: uphawu lwento nowenzayo kuyahluka.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Manje isho ukuthi ifasitela liphuke lodwa.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.1.r.d: 깬 isimo esisebenzayo esinophawu lwento 을; iphambene ne-깨졌.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.2.info:
Ehhovisi, 민호 uthi:
체육 시간에 제 공이 날아가서 유리창에 맞았어요. 일부러 한 건 아니에요.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yimiphi imibiko yesehlakalo manje oyithola inobulungisa? (Ingaphezulu kweyodwa ingafanelana.)
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Imibiko emibili ifanelana nendaba: leyo equnga imbangela (ibhola lakhe) ngaphandle kwesenzo sokusola, neqamba yena njengowenzayo kuyilapho isho ukuthi bekuyiphutha. Ukusho ukuthi wakwenza ngamabomu, noma ukuthi othile wamphoqa, kudlula ubufakazi.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lokhu kwengeza inhloso engasekelwa yilutho endabeni.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Isenzo sokwenza sisho ukuthi othile wenza 민호 wakwenza; akekho omunye ovela endabeni.
x-k-k8-10.s.s1.reflect: Umusho ongenaye owenzayo awusho ukuthi akekho owenzile, futhi umusho onomenzi uthatha ukuthi ukhona. Ukubika ngobulungisa kugcina lokhu kuhlukene.
x-k-k8-10.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ngesiKorea ukuthi ungabika kanjani isehlakalo ngokungathathi hlangothi kunhloko yesikole (ngaphandle kokusola): ifasitela liphuke ngoba ibhola lingene kulo ngesikhathi sezemidlalo.
x-k-k8-10.s.s2.hint.1: Engeza imbangela ngokhubhokhu onjenge-에 noma -어서, hhayi ngomuntu njengesihloko.
x-k-k8-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Umusho wami usho umphumela ngaphandle kokusola muntu?
x-k-k8-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Uqamba imbangela (ibhola) njengembangela, hhayi njengecala lomuntu?

x-k-k8-06.title: Yiziphi izinto ezinquma izinga lokukhuluma?
x-k-k8-06.goal: Nquma ukuthi yiziphi izingcezu zolwazi ezinquma ukuthi ukhuluma kanjani emlayezweni wokuqala, bese ubhala umbuzo onenhlonipho ocela eyodwa elahlekile.
x-k-k8-06.material: Ujoyine ingxoxo yekilasi lesiKorea ku-inthanethi. Umfundi wekilasi obizwa ngokuthi 하은 unesithombe seprofayela esibukeka esincane futhi akukho olunye ulwazi. Ufuna ukumthumelela umlayezo wokuqala oyimfihlo ukucela amanothi ekilasi. Ungabhala ngokukhuluma okunenhlonipho noma okungajwayelekile.
x-k-k8-06.prereq.0: Uyazi ukuthi amazinga okukhuluma esiKorea ancike kumlaleli
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi izinto okufanele uzidinge ngempela ukukhetha izinga lokukhuluma? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.hint.0: Zibuze: umkhulumi wesiKorea angashintsha ukuphela ngenxa yalesi sibalo?
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola inketho ngayinye: uma leli qiniso lishintsha, izinga lokukhuluma elilungile lingashintsha?
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.o.a: Ubudlelwano noma indima phakathi kwenu (umfundi ofunda naye, uthisha, umthengi ...)
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.r.a: Indima ibalulekile: uthisha, umthengi nomfundi ofunda naye bakhulunywa ngokuphela okuhlukile.
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.r.f: Ubudala obuhlobene bubalulekile: abantu ngokuvamile bakhuluma ngenhlonipho nomuntu omdala ngaphandle kokuvumelana ngenye indlela.
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.r.b: Amazinga okukhuluma esiKorea awancikile ekutheni umlaleli uyindoda noma owesifazane.
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi nina ningaba nivumelane kakade ukukhuluma ngokungajwayelekile
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.r.c: Isivumelwano sokukhuluma ngokungajwayelekile sishintsha okuyimvelo, ngakho kubalulekile.
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthi isithombe sakhe sibukeka sincane kangakanani
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.r.d: Izithombe zingadukisa futhi ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho kusebenzela wonke umuntu ongamazi.
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.o.e: Ukuthi umlayezo uyimfihlo noma uthunyelwe iqembu lonke
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.r.e: Umlayezo oyimfihlo neposi leqembu lonke kudinga amazinga ahlukile, ngakho isimo sibalulekile.
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.explain: Izinga lokukhuluma lincike endimeni, ebudaleni obuhlobene, ekuqondaneni okuvunyelwene nakho nasesimweni (oyimfihlo noma ovelele). Ubulili nesithombe azizona izimpawu ezithembekile; uma ungaqinisekile, ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho kuyisinqumo esiphephile.
x-k-k8-06.s.s1.acc.0: Indima, ubudala obuhlobene nesivumelwano yizinto ezimayelana nabantu ababili. Ukuthi umlayezo uyimfihlo noma ovelele kushintsha nezinga, kodwa ukuphatha isimo njengesesibili kuyindlela yokufunda enengqondo.
x-k-k8-06.s.s2.prompt: Awukwazi ukwazi iminyaka ka-하은. NgesiKorea, bhala umbuzo onenhlonipho umcela ukuthi ungakhuluma ngokungajwayelekile yini (noma ukuthi uthanda ukukhuluma kanjani).
x-k-k8-06.s.s2.hint.0: Abakhulumi besiKorea bavame ukubuza ini lapho befuna ukuqala ukukhuluma ngokungajwayelekile?
x-k-k8-06.s.s2.hint.1: Umbuzo ophela nge--ㄹ까요? uvumela omunye umuntu anqume.
x-k-k8-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Umbuzo wami umshiya akhululekile ukuthi cha?

x-k-k8-02.title: Isenzo esisodwa esingalungile ku-imeyili eya kuprofesa
x-k-k8-02.goal: Thola umusho we-imeyili enenhlonipho lapho umlobi azihlonipha yena esikhundleni sikaprofesa, chaza ukuthi kungani, bese ulungisa ngesimo esithobekile.
x-k-k8-02.material: Umfundi, 이서연, ubhalela uprofesa wakhe nge-imeyili ukuhlela ukuvakasha. Imigqa ibhalwe ngezinombolo kusukela ku-1.
x-k-k8-02.thinking.0: Ukuthola iphutha lezinga phakathi kwemigqa ethe xaxa elungile
x-k-k8-02.thinking.1: Ukuchaza ukuthi u--시- onenhlonipho angakhomba bani
x-k-k8-02.prereq.0: Wazi ukuthi u--시- uphakamisa umuntu owenza isenzo
x-k-k8-02.s.s1.prompt: Umugqa owodwa unephutha lezinga. Ngumugqa muphi?
x-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.0: Emgqeni ngamunye, qamba ukuthi ubani owenza isenzo. Ingabe u--시- noma esinye isimo sokuhlonipha sihambisana naleyo muntu?
x-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.1: Funda umugqa 3 ngokuvuthayo bese ubuza ukuthi umkhulumi uyazikhulisa noma uyazehlisa.
x-k-k8-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 usebenzisa u-오시겠습니다 no-제가 njengombhekiswa, ngakho umlobi uyazihlonipha. Isimo se--시- singesezenzo zikaprofesa (말씀하신, 괜찮으시면, 바쁘시면), kuyilapho izenzo zakhe zisebenzisa u-드리다 noma izenzo ezithobekile ezifana no-찾아뵙다.
x-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa nomugqa 4: ubani owenza u-보여 드리다, futhi u-드리다 wenzani?
x-k-k8-02.s.s2.o.a: Isimo se--시- sinamathiselwe esenzweni sikamlobi uqobo.
x-k-k8-02.s.s2.r.b: Hlola eminye imigqa: u--겠- uvela eminye imisho enhlonipho elungile, ngakho akuyona inkinga.
x-k-k8-02.s.s2.o.c: Igama lesikhathi u-내일 lilula kakhulu ku-imeyili.
x-k-k8-02.s.s2.r.c: U-내일 ligama elijwayelekile ekubhaleni okusemthethweni; inkinga isesenzweni.
x-k-k8-02.s.s2.r.d: Kokubili u-로 no-에 kusetshenziswa ngemva kuka-연구실 kulo musho; leli akulona iphutha.
x-k-k8-02.s.s2.explain: U--시- uphakamisa umbhekiswa wesenzo. Lapha umbhekiswa ngu-제가, ngakho umusho uphakamisa umlobi hhayi uprofesa.
x-k-k8-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha umugqa 3 ngesiKorea ukuze ulunge. Gcina incazelo: uzofika ehhovisi likaprofesa kusasa ngo-3 p.m.
x-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.0: Nquma ukuthi ubani ovunyelwe ukuthwala u--시- kulo musho, bese ukhetha isenzo esihambisana naleyo muntu.
x-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ungaguqula futhi umusho ube isicelo esinenhlonipho bese uvumela uprofesa anqume.
x-k-k8-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe umusho usazwakala unenhlonipho kuprofesa (isiphetho esinenhlonipho, isenzo esithobekile noma isicelo)?
x-k-k8-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Isimo sesicelo nasona silungisa iphutha ngoba uprofesa unquma.

x-k-k8-01.title: Ubani ophezulu kunobani kule chat?
x-k-k8-01.goal: Qagela isimo esihlobene sabantu abathathu ngamazinga okukhuluma angalinganiyo neziphawulo zokuhlonipha, bese uhlulela ukuthi impendulo yamazinga axubekile ayiphoxa inhlonipho yini.
x-k-k8-01.material:
I-chat yeqembu lezithandani zokuzisebenzela. Awutshelwa iminyaka noma indima yanoma ubani; ubona kuphela ukuthi bakhuluma kanjani.

Line 1 - 다은: 지후 씨, 어제 포스터 파일 보내 줬어요?
Line 2 - 지후: 네, 팀장님. 어제 저녁에 메일로 보내 드렸습니다.
Line 3 - 지후: 도윤아, 너 내일 올 수 있어?
Line 4 - 도윤: 응, 형. 내일은 갈 수 있어요.

(팀장님 = umholi weqembu; 형 = lokho indoda encane ibiza ngakho indoda endala esondelene nayo.)

x-k-k8-05.material: Uhlala nogogo wakho (할머니) nomfowenu oneminyaka eyi-8 (동생). Isidlo sakusihlwa sesilungile etafuleni. Ufuna ukutshela ngamunye wabo: 'Isidlo sakusihlwa sisetafuleni. Sicela uze udle.' Kumfowenu wengeza futhi: 'Geza izandla zakho kuqala.'
x-k-k8-05.thinking.0: Ukunquma ukuthi yiziphi izingxenye zomlayezo ezincike kumlaleli
x-k-k8-05.thinking.1: Ukwenza izinguqulo ezihloniphekile nezingajwayelekile zokuqukethwe okufanayo
x-k-k8-05.prereq.0: Uyazi ukuthi isiKorea sinamafomu ahloniphekile nangajwayelekile amabizo, izenzo nokuphela
x-k-k8-05.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi izingxenye zomlayezo okumele zishintshe uma uguqula umlayezo womfowenu ube ongugogo? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
x-k-k8-05.s.s1.hint.0: Yimaphi amagama achaza into engeyomlaleli noma eyenziwa ngumlaleli?
x-k-k8-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola inketho ngayinye: ifomu elinye linalo ifomu elihloniphekile elikhethekile?
x-k-k8-05.s.s1.r.c: Womabili amagama izinto ezingathathi hlangothi; ipheya ehloniphekile isebenza ekudleni nezenzo zomuntu.
x-k-k8-05.s.s1.explain: Ukudla nesenzo sokudla kungokomlaleli, ngakho kuthatha amafomu ahloniphekile (진지, 드시다). Izinto ezingathathi hlangothi namagama esikhathi akashintshi.
x-k-k8-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ngesiKorea lokho okusho kugogo: isidlo sakusihlwa sesilungile etafuleni; sicela uze udle.
x-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.0: Yiwaphi amagama amabili enguqulweni yomfowenu adinga ifomu elikhethekile kugogo?
x-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha ukuphela okucela ngenhlonipho esikhundleni sokuyala.
x-k-k8-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngisebenzise isihloniphi sokudla noma sokudla, hhayi kuphela u--요 onenhlonipho?
x-k-k8-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Umusho uyisicelo esizwakala sifudumele, hhayi umyalo?
x-k-k8-05.s.s3.prompt: Manje bhala ngesiKorea lokho okusho kumfowenu oneminyaka eyi-8: geza izandla zakho kuqala, bese uza udle.
x-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ukuphela okungajwayelekile kuvame ukuphela nge--어, -아 noma -자.
